description: This file defines the functionality for deleting comments in the Conduit application. It includes a Command object for passing deletion parameters, a Validator class to validate the command input, and a QueryHandler class implementing the logic to locate and delete a comment associated with an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Container class for commands, validators, and handlers related to deleting comments.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: DTO representing the parameters needed to delete a comment, including the article slug and comment ID.

classes.name: CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command to ensure the Slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete comment request by locating the article and comment, and performing the deletion.

methods.name: CommandValidator()
methods.description: Constructor for CommandValidator that sets validation rules for the Command.

methods.name: Handle(Command message, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the delete comment command, throws not found exceptions if article or comment do not exist, deletes the comment, and saves changes.
